# defectdojo_notifications (Resource)

Manages DefectDojo notification settings: on which channels (`slack`, `msteams`, `mail`, `webhooks`, `alert`) DefectDojo notifies of each event. The settings are system-wide, the template for new users, a user's personal settings, or a user's settings for one product. Managing them needs a superuser. Slack, Microsoft Teams, mail and webhooks also need to be set up in DefectDojo's system settings, and webhooks need a `defectdojo_notification_webhook`.

DefectDojo creates the system-wide settings and each user's personal settings itself, so creating this resource adopts existing settings of its scope. The resource manages every event: an event that isn't configured gets DefectDojo's default (`alert`, and none for `scan_added_empty`), so don't manage one scope with two resources.

Destroying the system-wide or a user's personal settings resets them to those defaults, without the template; deleting a user's personal settings would stop the user's notifications. Destroying a user's settings for a product, or the template, deletes them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The system-wide settings, which DefectDojo creates: the resource adopts
# them. Events that aren't set get DefectDojo's default, alert.
resource "defectdojo_notifications" "system" {
  sla_breach     = ["mail", "alert"]
  scan_added     = ["webhooks"]
  jira_update    = ["mail"]
  user_mentioned = []
}

# The template that DefectDojo copies into the settings of new users.
resource "defectdojo_notifications" "template" {
  template      = true
  product_added = ["mail", "alert"]
}

# A user's personal settings, which DefectDojo creates with the user.
resource "defectdojo_notifications" "jdoe" {
  user_id          = defectdojo_user.jdoe.id
  user_mentioned   = ["mail", "alert"]
  scan_added_empty = ["alert"]
}

# The user's settings for one product.
resource "defectdojo_notifications" "jdoe_storefront" {
  user_id    = defectdojo_user.jdoe.id
  product_id = defectdojo_product.storefront.id
  sla_breach = ["mail"]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `auto_close_engagement` (Set of String) The channels on which DefectDojo notifies when DefectDojo closes an engagement automatically. Defaults to `["alert"]`.
- `close_engagement` (Set of String) The channels on which DefectDojo notifies when an engagement is closed. Defaults to `["alert"]`.
- `code_review` (Set of String) The channels on which DefectDojo notifies when a code review is requested. Defaults to `["alert"]`.
- `engagement_added` (Set of String) The channels on which DefectDojo notifies when an engagement is added. Defaults to `["alert"]`.
- `jira_update` (Set of String) The channels on which DefectDojo notifies when the background Jira synchronization fails. Defaults to `["alert"]`.
- `other` (Set of String) The channels on which DefectDojo notifies when other events, such as a revoked API token. Defaults to `["alert"]`.
- `product_added` (Set of String) The channels on which DefectDojo notifies when a product is added. Defaults to `["alert"]`.
- `product_id` (Number) The ID of the product the user's settings apply to; they override the user's personal settings for it. Requires `user_id`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `product_type_added` (Set of String) The channels on which DefectDojo notifies when a product type is added. Defaults to `["alert"]`.
- `review_requested` (Set of String) The channels on which DefectDojo notifies when a review of findings is requested. Defaults to `["alert"]`.
- `risk_acceptance_expiration` (Set of String) The channels on which DefectDojo notifies when a risk acceptance expires. Defaults to `["alert"]`.
- `scan_added` (Set of String) The channels on which DefectDojo notifies when an import or reimport creates, updates or closes findings. Defaults to `["alert"]`.
- `scan_added_empty` (Set of String) The channel on which DefectDojo notifies when an import or reimport changes no findings. DefectDojo's API can set at most one channel for this event (its UI can set several). Defaults to none.
- `sla_breach` (Set of String) The channels on which DefectDojo notifies when a finding breaches its SLA. Defaults to `["alert"]`.
- `sla_breach_combined` (Set of String) The channels on which DefectDojo notifies when findings breach their SLA, in one combined notification. Defaults to `["alert"]`.
- `stale_engagement` (Set of String) The channels on which DefectDojo notifies when an engagement is past its end date. Defaults to `["alert"]`.
- `template` (Boolean) Whether these are the template that DefectDojo copies into the personal settings of each new user. Conflicts with `user_id` and `product_id`. Defaults to `false`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `test_added` (Set of String) The channels on which DefectDojo notifies when a test is added. Defaults to `["alert"]`.
- `upcoming_engagement` (Set of String) The channels on which DefectDojo notifies when an engagement is about to start. Defaults to `["alert"]`.
- `user_id` (Number) The ID of the user whose notification settings these are. Without `user_id` and `template`, these are the system-wide settings. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `user_mentioned` (Set of String) The channels on which DefectDojo notifies when the user is mentioned in a note. Defaults to `["alert"]`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the notification settings.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = defectdojo_notifications.example
  identity = {
    id = 2
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (Number) ID of the notification settings

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Notification settings are imported by their numeric ID
terraform import defectdojo_notifications.example <id>
```
